# Regional Coffee Market 2026H1

The regional coffee market grew 12% year over year to $4.2B in 2026H1, driven by
specialty demand and premiumization. Margin pressure persisted across roasters.

## Volumes

Total volume reached 18.4M bags, up from 16.9M in 2025H1. Arabica share rose to
61% (from 57%), while Robusta volumes fell 3% on adverse weather in key origins.

## Prices

Arabica spot averaged $2.31/lb (+18% YoY); Robusta averaged $1.72/lb (+9% YoY).
Futures contango narrowed through the quarter, signaling easing supply fears.

## Players

- Northern Roast: revenue $610M (+15%), 214 stores
- Bluepeak Coffee: revenue $480M (+8%), 180 stores
- Ember & Oak: revenue $310M (+21%), 96 stores

## Risks

Tariff escalation could add 4-6% to landed costs; climate volatility remains the
largest supply-side risk for 2027.
